main_text.head: DEMOMSTRATIO IMPLEMENTI AD DIVINITATEM Hujus cantici FIRMANDAM.
main_text.p: Supponentes iterum prophetiarum implementa divinam earundem simul confirmare originem, restat tantum modo, ut quousque hujus scenæ prædictiones sint adimpletæ ostendamus.

I. Fugatam fuisse (& ferè sine manu, post Judaeo-rum excidium) gentem, antea supra totum fere orbem dominatam, jam quasi à rupe suâ venditam, ut cum suis idololatriis aliis locum cedere coacta fuerit, videre licet in imperii Romani gentilis subitaneâ immutatione; quando Constantinus Maxentium, Licinius Maximinum vicit, & uterque Christianis libertatem cultus publici ex composito concessit. Audiamus Lactantium, rem omnem exponentem: ille in libro de mortibus Persecutorum Constantini victoriam cap. 44. In hunc modum describit. „Bellum per idoneos duces gerebatur. „Plus virium Maxentio erat, quod & patris sui exercitum receperat à Severo, & suum proprium de „Mauris atque Italis nuper extraxerat. Dimicatum,

page.notes: Printed "Demomstratio" in the title is a printing error, left as printed. The word "tantum modo" is partly shadowed by a stain; the reading "tantum" is doubtful. The initial S is a woodcut and is joined to "upponentes" as "Supponentes". The reading of the line-start quotation marks („) is uncertain, as is whether the first one is a quotation mark or a dash. Ink spots and foxing lie over the left-centre of the page, and some letters in "Fugatam", "Constantinus" and "subitaneâ" are hard to make out. No marginal notes are visible.
